next.reason: 1985: "If the execution of the WRITE statement is unsuccessful for a reason other than an invalid key condition, after updating the I-O status"; 2023: "If control is returned from those statements, then control is transferred to the end of the input-output statement.". 1985 also runs NOT INVALID KEY after a non-invalid-key failure, once the USE procedure ends. 2023 runs it only on success; a failure goes to the end of the statement.
